messages:
maya (AE): Heads up — Lyra sent back the RFI. They want a single package: capability matrix, written RFI answers, POC SOW (3wk), example pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted, and confirmation on HSM + long-term audit retention. Need out by EOD tomorrow. RFP: https://files.lyra/lyra_rfp_v3.pdf

devin (SE): I can run microbenches overnight. Main unknown: do they expect our INT8 runtime to be production-grade on Hosted? We only guarantee quantized performance on Dedicated hardware.

rachel (Solutions): Noted. I'll start the capability matrix CSV with a column for "Supported (Yes/Partial/No)", "Clarification", and "Recommended Mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)". Example rows: 

```
Feature,Supported,Clarification,Recommended Mode
HSM,BYOK for Dedicated,Customer-managed keys + HSM on Dedicated and Private,Private/Dedicated
INT8 quant,Partial,8-bit runtime supported on A100/A10; Hosted may use FP16 variants, Dedicated recommended,Dedicated
Audit log retention,Optional,7-year retention is an add-on with storage cost,Private/Dedicated
```

maya (AE): Also add a short written answer for their security questionnaire line items: encryption at rest/in transit, SOC2 status, EU data residency, patch cadence, etc. Put attachments for DPA + SOC2 summary.

tom (Legal): FYI: 7-year retention triggers compliance review and potential export control review for on-prem deliverables. I can draft the addendum language and a note on cost uplift.

ops-bot: Uploaded files: /attachments/lyra_rfp_v3.pdf, /templates/sow_poc_3w_example.docx, /templates/dpa_v2.pdf, /reports/soc2_summary.pdf

devin (SE): Scheduled perf run at 02:00 PT. Plan: run Lyra prompt set (attached) across FP16 and INT8 on a reserved A100 slot. I'll capture p50/p95/p99 latencies, throughput ramp, and memory. Also will test KV cache warm vs cold.

rachel (Solutions): Draft matrix v0.1 posted: https://redwood.internal/attachments/1735552468_matrix_v0.csv — pared down answers for each RFI line. I added a short FAQ blurb for quantization tradeoffs.

maya (AE): Great. Devin, when you have perf numbers, add a 1-paragraph interpretation for procurement: expected cost savings vs potential quality delta. We need something procurement can sign off on.

devin (SE): Results uploaded: https://redwood.internal/results/1735552468_perf.html — summary: INT8 shows ~25% token/sec increase vs FP16 on A100 with ~15% drop in some safety-classification consistency on their eval (we flagged 3/20 prompts). p95 for 512 tokens: INT8=280ms, FP16=360ms. Memory reduced ~28%. Raw CSV attached.

rachel (Solutions): Updating matrix with perf numbers and an explicit POC acceptance section. Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) p95 latency <= 350ms for 512 tokens on Dedicated; 2) Quality: >= 92% pass on Lyra eval set (we can accept +-2% for quantized runs); 3) Stability: no more than 1% request errors over a 1 hour sustained run.

maya (AE): That looks solid. I'll draft the email and package: matrix CSV, written RFI answers (PDF), SOW doc, DPA, perf report, and price sample. Tom please add the addendum wording for 7-year logs.

tom (Legal): Added addendum text and a note about cost. Suggest we mark long-retention as "optional paid add-on" and call out required approvals.

maya (AE): Final ask: Rachel, include a simple pricing table: example Hosted PAYG per-1k tokens, Dedicated small/medium/large monthly commit with example overage. Put a line item for audit-log storage for 7 years as estimated monthly cost.

rachel (Solutions): Pricing draft added to matrix v0.2. Example numbers (placeholder): Hosted: $0.003 /K input tokens, $0.02 /K output tokens. Dedicated: Small $12k/mo (up to 100k req/day), Med $40k/mo, Large $120k/mo; overage 20% of committed rate. Audit retention estimated $600/mo for 7yr cold storage.

devin (SE): All artifacts in one folder: https://redwood.internal/attachments/1735552468_package.zip. I also left the raw perf CSV and a short notes.txt about model mismatch on 3 prompts.

maya (AE): Sending to Lyra legal now. Thanks everyone. I'll flag follow-ups if they push back on retention or HSM scope. :rocket:
